description: This file defines the 'Article' class in the 'Conduit.Domain' namespace, representing an article entity in the application domain with properties for author, comments, tags, favorites, and timestamps.

classes.name: Article
classes.description: Represents an article with properties for ID, slug, title, description, body, author, comments, tags, favorites, and timestamps.

methods.name: Favorited
methods.description: Indicates whether the article has any favorites.

methods.name: FavoritesCount
methods.description: Returns the number of favorites the article has.

methods.name: TagList
methods.description: Returns a list of tag IDs associated with the article, filtering out null tag IDs.
